00-title.text: Your buyers stopped googling. They ask AI. Here's how to make it answer with your name

01-intro.text: This is your GEO dashboard. SEO is where you rank on Google. GEO is whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity name your brand when buyers ask them directly

02-sov.text: The big number is your share of voice. Out of all the brands the assistants mention, how often it's you. And here's the whole leaderboard, including everyone named instead of you

03-trend.text: Visibility over time shows every run as a point, so you see if you're gaining ground.

04-assistants.text: And by assistant, because ChatGPT and Claude don't answer the same way. You can be strong on one, invisible on the other

05-prompts-what.text: All of it is built from prompts. A prompt is just a question your buyer asks an AI, like, "Best soy candles for gifts." Every tracked prompt is asked on all four assistants

06-queries.text: Your prompts live here next to your keywords. Keywords are for Google. Prompts are for the assistants

07-add.text: Adding your own is one click. Track prompts, one per line, written the way a real customer would ask

08-added.text: Add them and they join every future run

09-run.text: Then re-ask. One click runs every prompt on all four assistants and updates the dashboard

10-domains.text: And the sources, which sites the assistants cite while answering. That's where you want to be mentioned

11-mentions.text: And one more thing feeds all of this: mentions. When an assistant answers, it runs a web search first. The higher a site's authority, the more likely it's what the AI reads about you

12-press.text: That's what this page grows. Rise publishes press releases to over three hundred sources, places guest posts, and builds backlink exchanges. Every mention teaches the assistants your brand exists

13-close.text: Track the questions your buyers actually ask. Grow the mentions, and you'll know exactly where AI sends them

01-geo.text: SEO gets you ranked on Google. GEO gets you named by ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini when buyers ask them what to buy. Different game. And it runs on one simple thing: how often the internet mentions you

02-mentions.text: That's what this page grows. Mentions are articles across the web that name your brand. Press releases and guest posts rise, writes, and places for you every month

03-press.text: And one press release never lands on just one site. Click the links. Published on seven sites. Rize pushes every release to a network of over three hundred news sources

04-why.text: Why does that matter? When the next ChatGPT or Claude gets trained, it reads the whole internet. The more places mention your brand, the better the new model knows you before anyone even asks

05-backlinks.text: Backlinks are the other half. Every one of these is a link from someone else's site back to yours with the page, the keyword, and the anchor it came with

06-geo-links.text: And they're not just for Google anymore. When ChatGPT searches the web to answer, it opens what ranks on top, big high traffic sites. Backlinks are what put you up there, so they raise your odds of being cited by AI too

07-prompts.text: Now, how do you measure any of this? With prompts. Keywords are what people type into Google. Prompts are what they ask an AI. Full questions, the way a real customer talks

08-track.text: Adding your own takes a click. One prompt per line, and every prompt gets checked on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

09-added.text: Add them and they join every future run

10-run.text: Then re-ask. One click runs every prompt on all four assistants and refreshes your numbers

11-dash.text: And here's where it all lands. Open the dashboard and switch to Geo

12-sov.text: The big number is your share of voice. Out of all the brands the assistants named, how often it was you, and your rank against every competitor they mention instead

13-trend.text: Visibility over time. Every run is a point on this line, so you see if you're gaining ground week over week

14-assistants.text: Then visibility by assistant. ChatGPT and Claude don't answer alike. You can be strong on one and invisible on another. Now you know exactly where to push

15-domains.text: The sources, the sites assistants cite while answering, and how often your domain shows up in them. This is exactly where mentions and backlinks put you

16-prompt-table.text: And every prompt one by one. Which assistant named you, at which position, and how that changed since the last run?

17-traffic.text: Finally, the payoff. Real visitors arriving on your site straight from AI chats, week by week, split by assistant, down to the exact pages they land on

18-close.text: So track the questions your buyers actually ask, grow your mentions and backlinks, and watch the answers change. That's Geo working for you
